Add three focused JUnit 5 regression tests to PricingCalculatorTest for the 10,000-cent bulk-discount threshold in DiscountPolicy (used via PricingCalculator), covering 9,999 (no discount), 10,000 (10% discount applies), and 10,001 (10% discount applies) cents, using the repo's existing single-item Order/Item test style. No production code changes. Then run the relevant tests to validate.

Implementation steps:
1. Confirm current threshold logic: DiscountPolicy.discountRate applies a 10% discount when subtotalCents >= 10_000 for non-VIP customers (PricingCalculator applies discountRate to subtotal and rounds).
2. Follow existing test conventions in /src/test/java/com/sweforge/pricing/PricingCalculatorTest.java (JUnit 5, single instantiated PricingCalculator field, @Test methods using assertEquals against calculator.calculateTotalCents(new Order(List.of(new Item(...))))).
3. Add a test for subtotal 9,999 cents (e.g., new Item(9_999)) asserting expected total equals 9_999 (no discount, since 9,999 < 10,000).
4. Add a test for subtotal exactly 10,000 cents (e.g., new Item(10_000)) asserting expected total equals 9_000 (10% discount applies at the boundary, since >= 10,000).
5. Add a test for subtotal 10,001 cents (e.g., new Item(10_001)) asserting expected total equals the rounded 10% discount, i.e., 9_001 cents (10,001 * 0.9 = 9,000.9, rounds to 9,001).
6. Use descriptive method names consistent with existing style, e.g. subtotalJustBelowThresholdHasNoDiscount, subtotalAtThresholdGetsBulkDiscount, subtotalJustAboveThresholdGetsBulkDiscount.
7. Do not modify DiscountPolicy.java, PricingCalculator.java, Order.java, or Item.java -- production code stays unchanged.
8. Run the relevant tests, e.g. `mvn -Dtest=PricingCalculatorTest test` (or full `mvn test` per pricing-build-validation skill) under Java 21, and confirm all pass including the three new boundary cases.

Validation:
- mvn -Dtest=PricingCalculatorTest test passes with all existing and new tests green
- mvn test (full suite) passes with no regressions
- Diff shows changes only in the test file (PricingCalculatorTest.java), no edits to src/main/java
- New tests explicitly cover subtotals of 9,999, 10,000, and 10,001 cents
